# In Praise of Idleness

*[Russell](../philosophers/russell.md) · 1932*

An essay in which Russell argues that modern technique has made a four-hour day possible, and that the gain has been spent on producing more rather than on freeing time. He analyses the duty to work as a legacy of societies where the leisure of a minority rested on the forced labour of the majority.
